subject.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache

question: Should gateway model pricing retain only the most recent 4,096 rows across refreshes, accepting cache misses for older rows in unusually large catalogs to prevent unbounded process memory growth?
rationale: The code and proof establish the implementation behavior, but choosing the permanent capacity and acceptable lookup-eviction semantics is a user-visible compatibility policy rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept the bounded recency policy
options.body: Merge after refreshing the merge head, treating bounded memory and recent-model retention as the intended gateway pricing-cache contract.

options.title: Choose a different retention contract
options.body: Pause for an owner-defined capacity or retention rule if all refreshed catalog rows must remain available without eviction.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded recency policy
recommendation.body: Merge after refreshing the merge head, treating bounded memory and recent-model retention as the intended gateway pricing-cache contract.
